name: mc_early_window_small_sufficient_history_stays_finite
description: AC-4 edge case. A history of exactly MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS days is sufficient (the MC path runs), but once the first MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS - 1 short-sample days are excluded the kNN candidate pool shrinks to a single day (MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS == MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS in the current constants, so 20 - 19 = 1 candidate). run_monte_carlo must still return a finite probability in [0, 100] from that degenerate one-day pool -- the early-window exclusion must not crash or emit NaN/Inf on a minimally-sufficient history.
provenance: Schema-derived synthetic history; day count taken from math_engine.MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS at test time.
contract: run_monte_carlo returns a finite float in [0, 100]; no NaN, no Inf, no exception. Shape/range invariant only -- no producer probability pinned.
derivation: With MC_MIN_HISTORY_DAYS == MC_VOL_WINDOW_DAYS, a minimally-sufficient history yields exactly one candidate after the early-window exclusion. rng.choice over a one-element pool is well-defined; the result must remain finite and bounded.
